title: Repeat steps with repeat
objective: Run the same lines again while a condition holds, or once for each item in a list.

body.text: Repeat while runs the indented lines again and again, for as long as its condition stays true. Change the value inside the loop, or the loop never stops. Use Stop to end a program that is running too long.

body.title: Count to three
body.code:
make changing i equal to 1
repeat while i is at most 3
    say "i = {i}"
    increase i by 1

body.text: repeat for each visits every item in a list, one at a time, and gives each item a name you choose. Lists are covered in the Data lesson.

body.title: Visit a list
body.code:
make fruits equal to a list of "apple", "pear"
repeat for each fruit in fruits
    say "I like {fruit}"

body.prompt: The loop stops at 3, but it should count from 1 all the way to 5. Make it print 1 to 5, one per line.
body.starter:
make changing i equal to 1
repeat while i is at most 3
    say "{i}"
    increase i by 1
body.solution:
make changing i equal to 1
repeat while i is at most 5
    say "{i}"
    increase i by 1
